drafts.title: The Race for Rescue
drafts.reasoning: This scene highlights the tension between Captain Hank and Officer John, setting up a dynamic that will play out throughout the story. It also introduces key elements of John’s frustration and Hank’s suspicion.
drafts.scene: In the dimly lit rubble-filled building where an unconscious girl lies on a makeshift stretcher, the three characters move with purpose but conflicting emotions. The air is thick with sweat and tension.

dialogue.line: What are you doing here, kid? I thought you were giving us your seminar on doughnuts.
Yeah, well, when lives are at stake, doughnuts can wait.
Nice to see your priorities align so perfectly with mine right now.
I told you, Sierra. Just be glad we got here in time.
And just what makes you think I believe that?
Look, it's not about convincing you. It's about saving someone who might need help right now.
